mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.contract_no AS contractNo, c.pdf_url AS pdfUrl, c.member_phone AS memberPhone, c.elder_id AS elderId, c.elder_name AS elderName, c.member_name AS memberName, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime, c.status, c.sort, c.level_desc AS levelDesc, c.create_time AS createTime, c.create_by AS createBy, c.update_time AS updateTime, c.update_by AS updateBy, c.remark, c.check_in_no AS checkInNo, c.sign_date AS signDate, c.release_submitter AS releaseSubmitter, c.release_date AS releaseDate, c.release_pdf_url AS releasePdfUrl, e.name AS elderName, e.id_card_no AS elderIdCardNo, e.age AS elderAge, e.sex AS elderSex, e.phone AS elderPhone, e.image AS elderImage, e.bed_number AS bedNumber, e.bed_id AS bedId, cfg.bed_no AS configBedNo, cfg.check_in_start_time AS checkInStartTime, cfg.check_in_end_time AS checkInEndTime, cfg.cost_start_time AS costStartTime, cfg.cost_end_time AS costEndTime, cfg.deposit_amount AS depositAmount, cfg.nursing_cost AS nursingCost, cfg.bed_cost AS bedCost, cfg.other_cost AS otherCost, cfg.medical_insurance_payment AS medicalInsurancePayment, cfg.government_subsidy AS governmentSubsidy, nl.name AS nursingLevelName, nl.fee AS nursingLevelFee FROM `contract` c LEFT JOIN `elder` e ON c.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN `check_in_config` cfg ON c.elder_id = cfg.elder_id LEFT JOIN `nursing_level` nl ON cfg.nursing_level_id = nl.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
